title: Arcade Odyssey
specs: New, Ultra Rare, Imported, Retro and Classic Arcade Games, Music games, and a large assortment of Pinball machines
Wide variety of Mexican cokes, Japanese Drinks & snacks, Ramune flavors, Pocky, Bubble tea, Yakisoba
One of the only surviving arcades of its kind in Miami-Dade
Featured on Popular Mechanics as one of the Top 8 retro arcades to visit in the US

blurb: Arcade Odyssey offers a variety of arcade games including Fighters, Shoot'em-ups, Music games, and pinball machines. They also provide a wide selection of Mexican cokes, Japanese drinks and snacks, craft and imported beers, sakes, and tipsy teas. Party and private event reservations are available.
